body:
spotted tonight: Electric Lady Studios, Greenwich Village — the same building where Lover, Midnights, and The Tortured Poets Department all came together.

she was here a month ago too, for a nine-hour session that had fans buzzing about a 13th album — until a competing rumor called it a birthday party instead. nobody outside that building actually knows.

so we're just going to ask: is she back in the room, or is this just where she goes to feel normal for a night? tell us your theory 👇
